tested_hypotheses: Redirect Skill admission is the only trigger; Normal and Ultimate casts grant nothing.
The buff does not stack and does not refresh: a Redirect cast admitted while the buff is active leaves one stack with the original expiry (BuffManager RefreshPolicy::Disallow, max_stacks 1).
A Redirect cast admitted after expiry grants a fresh full-duration buff.
The buff is wearer-only (BuffRecipient::SpecificActor) and uses Snapshot source lifetime, so switching does not clear it.
The +90/+108/+126/+144/+162 point values and 50s duration are bound from CT_ForkBuff through the refinement DataList with bIsPercent=false unit checks.

The staged +BI points join the break damage zone additively as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 5) per core zone math; the adapter-to-zone link has no runtime consumer yet and is a return condition.
Arc: Picky (summoning Picky to unlock lockable objects) is non-combat and explicitly unmodeled.
Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
